routes.name: Homepage
routes.goal: Make capability and fit evident in first 5 seconds
routes.sections: Hero with rotating editorial project index; four core service pathways; selected case studies with sector and area; deliverables timeline; materials/process story; editorial journal; quote CTA
routes.actions: Hero projects link to correct case; tabs change project imagery; sticky inquiry preselects service; skip animation accessibility
routes.acceptance: Above-fold screenshot AR+EN reads as a construction company, not SaaS

routes.name: Project atlas
routes.goal: Let buyer narrow references comparable to own project
routes.sections: Featured project; sidebar multi-filter sector, scope, city, area; reset; sort newest/area; results count; masonry/list switch; empty state
routes.actions: Filtering AND across dimensions; filters URL deep-linkable, back/forward working; project cards link
routes.acceptance: Filtered count and content match source dataset after refresh

routes.name: Project case study
routes.goal: Demonstrate breadth of an example project without false claims
routes.sections: Project identity; objective; constraints; scope and phases; annotated gallery; materials spec; design intent; download demo brief; related projects
routes.actions: Keyboard zoom gallery; before/after draggable; project-level contact prefill; gallery touch swipes
routes.acceptance: No unsupported completion stats or client names; all images coherent to same fictional property

routes.name: Services index
routes.sections: Service navigator; work type selector; deliverable comparisons; typical inputs; exclusions; sectors; related cases
routes.actions: Select service to detail; request quote prefill
routes.acceptance: Each service has different deliverables and tailored copy

routes.name: Service dossier
routes.goal: Describe specific work for informed purchase
routes.sections: Overview; suitability; included/excluded scope; engagement sequence; dependencies; FAQs; 3 applicable cases
routes.actions: Scope CTA passes service and optional project; accordion keyboard usable
routes.acceptance: Refreshing deep link retains selected service

routes.name: Project methodology
routes.goal: Make realistic tender and handover stages concrete
routes.sections: Discovery intake; site survey; BOQ planning; procurement coordination; execution; QC/handover; illustrative artefact thumbnails
routes.actions: Phase accordion, scope checklist download or print
routes.acceptance: No promise of licensing or certification not provided

routes.name: Insights
routes.sections: Topic archive; search; category cards; related services
routes.actions: Search and pagination, article cards lead to real routes
routes.acceptance: All six articles unique Arabic/English substantive content

routes.name: Article
routes.sections: Intro, sections with diagram/table as relevant, glossary, related cases, next article
routes.acceptance: Structured hierarchy and reading progress functional

routes.name: Tender scope wizard
routes.sections: Step 1 building sector and project stage; 2 scope services and approximate area; 3 constraints/timeline/budget band; 4 file checklist; 5 review; 6 receipt
routes.actions: Validate cross-fields; retain draft; back and edit; persist anonymized demo submission in SQLite; print summary
routes.acceptance: Completing journey creates scoped record, no real contractor contacted

routes.name: Studio profile
routes.sections: Work philosophy; team roles as illustrative; fieldwork methods; detailed FAQ
routes.acceptance: No fake ISO, awards, years or authentic testimonials

routes.name: Contact & offices
routes.sections: Sample contact routes; inquiry guide; Mavvix cross-site inquiry
routes.actions: Only Mavvix CTA leaves demo; fictional contact routes do not submit outbound
routes.acceptance: No fictional phone dial / address pin that pretends physical office

flows.name: Tender for an office renovation
flows.steps: Home > Projects > filter commercial+interiors > project atlas-office-01 > review gallery+constraints > Similar scope > wizard prefilled > add area and required works > review > DEMO request receipt > admin sees request tagged construction.
flows.oracle: Required area positive; 2+ compatible services; demo-only confirmation and DB record visible in operator area.

flows.name: Compare finishing packages
flows.steps: Services > Fit-out > Deliverables > Browse related references > share permalink > request-scope, selected package remains.
flows.oracle: Service selection and referral context survive refresh, deep-link and language switch.

flows.name: Project search failure path
flows.steps: Projects > choose conflicting filters > purposeful zero-state > clear one dimension > results return > open relevant project.
flows.oracle: No fake count, no dead end or unresponsive reset.

design: Architectural journal, ink #162327 / limestone #F2EFE9 / rust #D26A3B. Bold architecturally cropped hero with measured grid and vertical project rail; image-led detail, project index typography and annotated plan-like drawings. Avoid generic 3-card hero and blue gradients. AR IBM Plex Sans Arabic; EN Manrope. Mobile uses visual timeline and collapsible spec sheets.
signatureFeatures: Project Atlas Explorer: sector x service x 6 area bands; URL-searchParams synced
Immersive before/after comparison on illustrative projects, keyboard accessible
Tender Scope Wizard with dependencies, review screen and persistent DEMO RFQ receipt
Technical service packages with clear deliverables/exclusions and related work
Project cross-references based on sector and work type
seedRequirements: 12 projects (at least 3 sectors, 4 scope families, diverse size/location), 7 service packages, 6 journal posts, 12 gallery sets (minimum 3 images each), 6 FAQs, 2 featured case deep dives, 2 downloadable DEMO scope-checklist sheets.
adminRequirements: Manage project records, multilingual cases, gallery order and alt text, service packages, FAQs and articles; update visibility/featured ordering; see demo RFQ submissions by scope/sector and status (new/reviewed/archived), never send an external quotation. Changing project visibility updates index, filters, home and sitemap previews.
negativeScenarios: A 420 m² villa scope, two service packages, future requested start
Office fit-out 850 m², constrained access, filtered using city+sector
Archived project should disappear publicly but remain in admin
RFQ with 0 m² / invalid category is rejected
Same quote form submitted twice via rapid taps must not duplicate confirmation
